name: How long does garage door frame repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does garage door frame repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of garage door frame repair varies depending on the severity and type of damage. Minor repairs, such as addressing small cracks or dents, might be completed within a few hours. More extensive repairs involving significant rot removal, structural component replacement, or custom fabrication could take a full day or potentially longer if specialized materials need to be ordered. A professional assessment will provide a more accurate time estimate once the damage has been evaluated.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor issues to a full day or more for extensive structural damage, depending on the damage type and severity.
